title: Banjo-Kazooie
blurb: A wisecracking red-crested breegull who lives in her bear companion Banjo's backpack, providing flight, combat, and most of the duo's attitude.
facts: The games generally involve the pair in conflict with the evil witch Gruntilda Winkybunion.
